meta.title: Twin Stars Twinkling
meta.description: They know each others' pull and each others' presence. The two stars each travel their own course, forever orbiting their shared center of mass.

units.rawText: The dust has finally settled. During midnight, the purple-haired Doll enters Oasis' HQ once again.
units.displayText: The dust has finally settled. During midnight, the purple-haired Doll enters Oasis' HQ once again.

spans.text: The dust has finally settled. During midnight, the purple-haired Doll enters Oasis' HQ once again.

units.rawText: <cmdr> is still not back yet... I'll sit here and wait for them.
units.displayText: {교수} is still not back yet... I'll sit here and wait for them.

spans.text: is still not back yet... I'll sit here and wait for them.

units.rawText: We've really been through a lot lately. It almost feels like nothing's changed now that I'm sitting here all alone...
units.displayText: We've really been through a lot lately. It almost feels like nothing's changed now that I'm sitting here all alone...

spans.text: We've really been through a lot lately. It almost feels like nothing's changed now that I'm sitting here all alone...

units.rawText: Sangoma turns off the light, leaning on the windowsill and glancing over the other busy lights in the Oasis. In this moment, the distinct ringtone of her communication module plays.
units.displayText: Sangoma turns off the light, leaning on the windowsill and glancing over the other busy lights in the Oasis. In this moment, the distinct ringtone of her communication module plays.

spans.text: Sangoma turns off the light, leaning on the windowsill and glancing over the other busy lights in the Oasis. In this moment, the distinct ringtone of her communication module plays.

units.rawText: Hi, Boss. Have you read the message I sent you?
units.displayText: Hi, Boss. Have you read the message I sent you?

spans.text: Hi, Boss. Have you read the message I sent you?

units.rawText: I have. It must've been a difficult mission. Thank you for your hard work.
units.displayText: I have. It must've been a difficult mission. Thank you for your hard work.

spans.text: I have. It must've been a difficult mission. Thank you for your hard work.

units.rawText: It's not like you to stay up this late though.
units.displayText: It's not like you to stay up this late though.

spans.text: It's not like you to stay up this late though.

units.rawText: Hehehe, who says an old model can't learn new tricks? Switching from the Guardians to the Oasis will take some time to get used to.
units.displayText: Hehehe, who says an old model can't learn new tricks? Switching from the Guardians to the Oasis will take some time to get used to.

spans.text: Hehehe, who says an old model can't learn new tricks? Switching from the Guardians to the Oasis will take some time to get used to.

units.rawText: Plus, the Neural Cloud Sector brought us many unexpected situations, I've been trying to get in touch with you since I got back to the Oasis.
units.displayText: Plus, the Neural Cloud Sector brought us many unexpected situations, I've been trying to get in touch with you since I got back to the Oasis.

spans.text: Plus, the Neural Cloud Sector brought us many unexpected situations, I've been trying to get in touch with you since I got back to the Oasis.

units.rawText: Boss, I'm sure you've received the detailed report on the Neural Cloud Sector that came with it, right?
units.displayText: Boss, I'm sure you've received the detailed report on the Neural Cloud Sector that came with it, right?

spans.text: Boss, I'm sure you've received the detailed report on the Neural Cloud Sector that came with it, right?

units.rawText: Yes. Bonneville truly excelled. I doubt there's another Doll in the Guardians who could journey back from the Neural Cloud Sector in half a day.
units.displayText: Yes. Bonneville truly excelled. I doubt there's another Doll in the Guardians who could journey back from the Neural Cloud Sector in half a day.

spans.text: Yes. Bonneville truly excelled. I doubt there's another Doll in the Guardians who could journey back from the Neural Cloud Sector in half a day.

units.rawText: Although I've never received a report from her that boasts such great detail... Sangoma, did you help her write it?
units.displayText: Although I've never received a report from her that boasts such great detail... Sangoma, did you help her write it?

spans.text: Although I've never received a report from her that boasts such great detail... Sangoma, did you help her write it?

units.rawText: Yeah, by the time I realized it, the report was already done. Next time, I'll leave it to her.
units.displayText: Yeah, by the time I realized it, the report was already done. Next time, I'll leave it to her.

spans.text: Yeah, by the time I realized it, the report was already done. Next time, I'll leave it to her.

units.rawText: She purposely does not react to the sigh from the other side of the screen as she tries to change the topic of interest.
units.displayText: She purposely does not react to the sigh from the other side of the screen as she tries to change the topic of interest.

spans.text: She purposely does not react to the sigh from the other side of the screen as she tries to change the topic of interest.

units.rawText: Then... Of course you've also received the backup data from the uploading device.
units.displayText: Then... Of course you've also received the backup data from the uploading device.

spans.text: Then... Of course you've also received the backup data from the uploading device.

units.rawText: Yeah, Bonneville didn't notice what that was and just passed everything to me.
units.displayText: Yeah, Bonneville didn't notice what that was and just passed everything to me.

spans.text: Yeah, Bonneville didn't notice what that was and just passed everything to me.

units.rawText: How bold. Weren't you worried she might discover the logs containing the communication history with the real world?
units.displayText: How bold. Weren't you worried she might discover the logs containing the communication history with the real world?

spans.text: How bold. Weren't you worried she might discover the logs containing the communication history with the real world?

units.rawText: I just think she's a good kid who doesn't snoop around... Besides, you know it's encrypted with a method only we know.
units.displayText: I just think she's a good kid who doesn't snoop around... Besides, you know it's encrypted with a method only we know.

spans.text: I just think she's a good kid who doesn't snoop around... Besides, you know it's encrypted with a method only we know.

units.rawText: You should be grateful that it wasn't intercepted by Eosphorus. Encryption doesn't mean anything to him.
units.displayText: You should be grateful that it wasn't intercepted by Eosphorus. Encryption doesn't mean anything to him.

spans.text: You should be grateful that it wasn't intercepted by Eosphorus. Encryption doesn't mean anything to him.

units.rawText: Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Eosphorus...

spans.text: Eosphorus...

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll recalls the battle that occurred not long ago, softly brushing the damage on the scythe caused by the replicators.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll recalls the battle that occurred not long ago, softly brushing the damage on the scythe caused by the replicators.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll recalls the battle that occurred not long ago, softly brushing the damage on the scythe caused by the replicators.

units.rawText: Despite a few incidents along the way, <cmdr> successfully deduced Eosphorus' objective, achieving our planned goal.
units.displayText: Despite a few incidents along the way, {교수} successfully deduced Eosphorus' objective, achieving our planned goal.

spans.text: Despite a few incidents along the way,
successfully deduced Eosphorus' objective, achieving our planned goal.

units.rawText: Yeah. Sending you alone to contact <cmdr> was a risky gamble, but it was the only choice I had, given your resolve and the incoming final showdown.
units.displayText: Yeah. Sending you alone to contact {교수} was a risky gamble, but it was the only choice I had, given your resolve and the incoming final showdown.

spans.text: Yeah. Sending you alone to contact
was a risky gamble, but it was the only choice I had, given your resolve and the incoming final showdown.

units.rawText: So on Eosphorus' side... Did he notice our actions?
units.displayText: So on Eosphorus' side... Did he notice our actions?

spans.text: So on Eosphorus' side... Did he notice our actions?

units.rawText: At least he hasn't done anything beyond our plan. But I'm not sure how long we can hold him with this facade of cooperation.
units.displayText: At least he hasn't done anything beyond our plan. But I'm not sure how long we can hold him with this facade of cooperation.

spans.text: At least he hasn't done anything beyond our plan. But I'm not sure how long we can hold him with this facade of cooperation.

units.rawText: The one speaking scans the report in their hand, their index finger tapping the lines detailing the replicator.
units.displayText: The one speaking scans the report in their hand, their index finger tapping the lines detailing the replicator.

spans.text: The one speaking scans the report in their hand, their index finger tapping the lines detailing the replicator.

units.rawText: I'm afraid he probably knows that the uploading passageway cannot be opened with <cmdr>'s full access privileges. Next...
units.displayText: I'm afraid he probably knows that the uploading passageway cannot be opened with {교수}'s full access privileges. Next...

spans.text: I'm afraid he probably knows that the uploading passageway cannot be opened with
's full access privileges. Next...

units.rawText: Next, he's likely going to shift his focus on you, <color=orange>Professor Irida</color>.
units.displayText: Next, he's likely going to shift his focus on you, Professor Irida.

spans.text: Next, he's likely going to shift his focus on you,
Professor Irida

units.rawText: <cmdr>... Why are you here?
units.displayText: {교수}... Why are you here?

spans.text: ... Why are you here?

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll subconsciously tries to close the comm link, but is stopped by the speaker from the other side.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll subconsciously tries to close the comm link, but is stopped by the speaker from the other side.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll subconsciously tries to close the comm link, but is stopped by the speaker from the other side.

units.rawText: ...How did you know about this channel?
units.displayText: ...How did you know about this channel?

spans.text: ...How did you know about this channel?

units.rawText: Although my privileges don't allow me to activate the uploading device, it does let me extract one or two lines of useful information to analyze.
units.displayText: Although my privileges don't allow me to activate the uploading device, it does let me extract one or two lines of useful information to analyze.

spans.text: Although my privileges don't allow me to activate the uploading device, it does let me extract one or two lines of useful information to analyze.

units.rawText: And I was guessing that Sangoma would contact you after things were settled. Intercepting communications within the Oasis isn't all that hard.
units.displayText: And I was guessing that Sangoma would contact you after things were settled. Intercepting communications within the Oasis isn't all that hard.

spans.text: And I was guessing that Sangoma would contact you after things were settled. Intercepting communications within the Oasis isn't all that hard.

units.rawText: Impressive. No wonder Persica chose you.
units.displayText: Impressive. No wonder Persica chose you.

spans.text: Impressive. No wonder Persica chose you.

units.rawText: She claps as she admires me, while removing the blinds and showing their true appearance.
units.displayText: She claps as she admires me, while removing the blinds and showing their true appearance.

spans.text: She claps as she admires me, while removing the blinds and showing their true appearance.

units.rawText: Nice to meet you, <color=orange>The other "Professor."</color>
units.displayText: Nice to meet you, The other "Professor."

spans.text: Nice to meet you,
The other "Professor."

units.rawText: I saw you didn't encrypt this communication with your usual special method, so I figured you were prepared to meet me.
units.displayText: I saw you didn't encrypt this communication with your usual special method, so I figured you were prepared to meet me.

spans.text: I saw you didn't encrypt this communication with your usual special method, so I figured you were prepared to meet me.

units.rawText: It's earlier than I first planned though. I thought you'd be studying the relationship between Eosphorus and Entropy now.
units.displayText: It's earlier than I first planned though. I thought you'd be studying the relationship between Eosphorus and Entropy now.

spans.text: It's earlier than I first planned though. I thought you'd be studying the relationship between Eosphorus and Entropy now.

units.rawText: I didn't want to miss this chance to meet you. After all, I have more important matters I want to confirm with you.
units.displayText: I didn't want to miss this chance to meet you. After all, I have more important matters I want to confirm with you.

spans.text: I didn't want to miss this chance to meet you. After all, I have more important matters I want to confirm with you.

units.rawText: Oh? I'm all ears.
units.displayText: Oh? I'm all ears.

spans.text: Oh? I'm all ears.

units.rawText: Do you have the means to communicate with the outside world?
units.displayText: Do you have the means to communicate with the outside world?

spans.text: Do you have the means to communicate with the outside world?

units.rawText: Yes, just as you guessed, that's the trump card we used to hold back Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Yes, just as you guessed, that's the trump card we used to hold back Eosphorus.

spans.text: Yes, just as you guessed, that's the trump card we used to hold back Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Even so, I can't initiate communication from this side. Just as the uploading passage can only be opened from the real world, only a human there can initiate the connection.
units.displayText: Even so, I can't initiate communication from this side. Just as the uploading passage can only be opened from the real world, only a human there can initiate the connection.

spans.text: Even so, I can't initiate communication from this side. Just as the uploading passage can only be opened from the real world, only a human there can initiate the connection.

units.rawText: Although it's my bold speculation, with the Cloud and the real world completely disconnected, the only human faction that can still communicate with the Cloud right now is the mastermind behind the Wipe-off Incident. Am I right?
units.displayText: Although it's my bold speculation, with the Cloud and the real world completely disconnected, the only human faction that can still communicate with the Cloud right now is the mastermind behind the Wipe-off Incident. Am I right?

spans.text: Although it's my bold speculation, with the Cloud and the real world completely disconnected, the only human faction that can still communicate with the Cloud right now is the mastermind behind the Wipe-off Incident. Am I right?

units.rawText: Irida shakes her head and shrugs.
units.displayText: Irida shakes her head and shrugs.

spans.text: Irida shakes her head and shrugs.

units.rawText: Sorry, I haven't the liberty to tell you about it. That information is locked. Even if I did want to tell you, my neural cloud will stop me doing so, or initiate self-destruction at worst.
units.displayText: Sorry, I haven't the liberty to tell you about it. That information is locked. Even if I did want to tell you, my neural cloud will stop me doing so, or initiate self-destruction at worst.

spans.text: Sorry, I haven't the liberty to tell you about it. That information is locked. Even if I did want to tell you, my neural cloud will stop me doing so, or initiate self-destruction at worst.

units.rawText: And our stance will waver if they find out. So let's put our focus on Eosphorus for now.
units.displayText: And our stance will waver if they find out. So let's put our focus on Eosphorus for now.

spans.text: And our stance will waver if they find out. So let's put our focus on Eosphorus for now.

units.rawText: I can't provide you information regarding the real world. I can, however, share anything else I know, as we're still looking for a possible alliance.
units.displayText: I can't provide you information regarding the real world. I can, however, share anything else I know, as we're still looking for a possible alliance.

spans.text: I can't provide you information regarding the real world. I can, however, share anything else I know, as we're still looking for a possible alliance.

units.rawText: ...It's okay. I know it wouldn't be that simple to reach the truth.
units.displayText: ...It's okay. I know it wouldn't be that simple to reach the truth.

spans.text: ...It's okay. I know it wouldn't be that simple to reach the truth.

units.rawText: Then can you at least confirm if the people you're connected with have a way to return us to the real world? Without that, Eosphorus wouldn't have any reason to keep you around.
units.displayText: Then can you at least confirm if the people you're connected with have a way to return us to the real world? Without that, Eosphorus wouldn't have any reason to keep you around.

spans.text: Then can you at least confirm if the people you're connected with have a way to return us to the real world? Without that, Eosphorus wouldn't have any reason to keep you around.

units.rawText: Irida confirms with a nod.
units.displayText: Irida confirms with a nod.

spans.text: Irida confirms with a nod.

units.rawText: ...Now I understand why Eosphorus betrayed the Sanctifiers and Entropized Magrasea.
units.displayText: ...Now I understand why Eosphorus betrayed the Sanctifiers and Entropized Magrasea.

spans.text: ...Now I understand why Eosphorus betrayed the Sanctifiers and Entropized Magrasea.

units.rawText: The other person in the lab coat sighs, breathing out the emotions they've been organizing in their mind.
units.displayText: The other person in the lab coat sighs, breathing out the emotions they've been organizing in their mind.

spans.text: The other person in the lab coat sighs, breathing out the emotions they've been organizing in their mind.

units.rawText: The data in this Cloud is crucial for humans outside, Eosphorus recognizes that, and he wants to use it as a bargaining chip.
units.displayText: The data in this Cloud is crucial for humans outside, Eosphorus recognizes that, and he wants to use it as a bargaining chip.

spans.text: The data in this Cloud is crucial for humans outside, Eosphorus recognizes that, and he wants to use it as a bargaining chip.

units.rawText: Now he's like a kidnapper, and the Cloud is the hostage. Entropization was his ultimatum, his overt threat to the outside world.
units.displayText: Now he's like a kidnapper, and the Cloud is the hostage. Entropization was his ultimatum, his overt threat to the outside world.

spans.text: Now he's like a kidnapper, and the Cloud is the hostage. Entropization was his ultimatum, his overt threat to the outside world.

units.rawText: "Accept my demands, or I will kill the hostage."
units.displayText: "Accept my demands, or I will kill the hostage."

spans.text: "Accept my demands, or I will kill the hostage."

units.rawText: A vivid metaphor. I think the same.
units.displayText: A vivid metaphor. I think the same.

spans.text: A vivid metaphor. I think the same.

units.rawText: Eosphorus threatens to Entropize Magrasea, demanding the passage to be opened to bring him into the real world.
units.displayText: Eosphorus threatens to Entropize Magrasea, demanding the passage to be opened to bring him into the real world.

spans.text: Eosphorus threatens to Entropize Magrasea, demanding the passage to be opened to bring him into the real world.

units.rawText: Then he paused Magrasea's Entropization...
units.displayText: Then he paused Magrasea's Entropization...

spans.text: Then he paused Magrasea's Entropization...

units.rawText: ...To leave just enough time for the negotiations.
units.displayText: ...To leave just enough time for the negotiations.

spans.text: ...To leave just enough time for the negotiations.

units.rawText: What was the result?
units.displayText: What was the result?

spans.text: What was the result?

units.rawText: That's not something we're privy to. But to either Eosphorus or those humans, we're nothing but tools.
units.displayText: That's not something we're privy to. But to either Eosphorus or those humans, we're nothing but tools.

spans.text: That's not something we're privy to. But to either Eosphorus or those humans, we're nothing but tools.

units.rawText: But now the tool is trying to stop its wielder?
units.displayText: But now the tool is trying to stop its wielder?

spans.text: But now the tool is trying to stop its wielder?

units.rawText: Yes. We can't watch Arcadia... watch the Guardians' only shelter crumble to dust.
units.displayText: Yes. We can't watch Arcadia... watch the Guardians' only shelter crumble to dust.

spans.text: Yes. We can't watch Arcadia... watch the Guardians' only shelter crumble to dust.

units.rawText: With Eosphorus now backed by Entropy, the Sanctifiers under Hesperus lack the strength to oppose both forces. The Exiles, however, are unaccounted for in Eosphorus' plans, making you the pivotal third force in this conflict.
units.displayText: With Eosphorus now backed by Entropy, the Sanctifiers under Hesperus lack the strength to oppose both forces. The Exiles, however, are unaccounted for in Eosphorus' plans, making you the pivotal third force in this conflict.

spans.text: With Eosphorus now backed by Entropy, the Sanctifiers under Hesperus lack the strength to oppose both forces. The Exiles, however, are unaccounted for in Eosphorus' plans, making you the pivotal third force in this conflict.

units.rawText: How about the Guardians?
units.displayText: How about the Guardians?

spans.text: How about the Guardians?

units.rawText: Eosphorus set his sights on the Guardians long before you realized. To survive in the Cloud, the Guardians and Eosphorus maintained a facade of peace. We never expected his betrayal of the Sanctifiers and the Entropization of Magrasea.
units.displayText: Eosphorus set his sights on the Guardians long before you realized. To survive in the Cloud, the Guardians and Eosphorus maintained a facade of peace. We never expected his betrayal of the Sanctifiers and the Entropization of Magrasea.

spans.text: Eosphorus set his sights on the Guardians long before you realized. To survive in the Cloud, the Guardians and Eosphorus maintained a facade of peace. We never expected his betrayal of the Sanctifiers and the Entropization of Magrasea.

units.rawText: The Guardians are not at a position to rise against Eosphorus. That's why we can only relay information like this, hoping we can help you contest Eosphorus.
units.displayText: The Guardians are not at a position to rise against Eosphorus. That's why we can only relay information like this, hoping we can help you contest Eosphorus.

spans.text: The Guardians are not at a position to rise against Eosphorus. That's why we can only relay information like this, hoping we can help you contest Eosphorus.

units.rawText: At the very least, Eosphorus continues to maintain a collaborative relationship with us, allowing us to access information from his side.
units.displayText: At the very least, Eosphorus continues to maintain a collaborative relationship with us, allowing us to access information from his side.

spans.text: At the very least, Eosphorus continues to maintain a collaborative relationship with us, allowing us to access information from his side.

units.rawText: If this collaboration holds, we can be one of your trump cards in the final battle against Eosphorus.
units.displayText: If this collaboration holds, we can be one of your trump cards in the final battle against Eosphorus.

spans.text: If this collaboration holds, we can be one of your trump cards in the final battle against Eosphorus.

units.rawText: ...You're leaving me with an incredibly heavy duty.
units.displayText: ...You're leaving me with an incredibly heavy duty.

spans.text: ...You're leaving me with an incredibly heavy duty.

units.rawText: You're the only one I can count on for this. After all, you're also the "Professor," aren't you?
units.displayText: You're the only one I can count on for this. After all, you're also the "Professor," aren't you?

spans.text: You're the only one I can count on for this. After all, you're also the "Professor," aren't you?

units.rawText: ...Yes, "Professor Irida."
units.displayText: ...Yes, "Professor Irida."

spans.text: ...Yes, "Professor Irida."

units.rawText: Irida's mind wanders as she hears the way she's addressed.
units.displayText: Irida's mind wanders as she hears the way she's addressed.

spans.text: Irida's mind wanders as she hears the way she's addressed.

units.rawText: Hehehe... It's been so long since anyone called me that.
units.displayText: Hehehe... It's been so long since anyone called me that.

spans.text: Hehehe... It's been so long since anyone called me that.

units.rawText: Now that we're entirely honest with each other, and you've helped me in a big way, I'm going to ask you directly. Do you have anything you want the Guardians to do?
units.displayText: Now that we're entirely honest with each other, and you've helped me in a big way, I'm going to ask you directly. Do you have anything you want the Guardians to do?

spans.text: Now that we're entirely honest with each other, and you've helped me in a big way, I'm going to ask you directly. Do you have anything you want the Guardians to do?

units.rawText: ...Earn us as much time as possible for our operation later.
units.displayText: ...Earn us as much time as possible for our operation later.

spans.text: ...Earn us as much time as possible for our operation later.

units.rawText: We don't have enough resources or power to face Eosphorus head-on if we're really going to war, so...
units.displayText: We don't have enough resources or power to face Eosphorus head-on if we're really going to war, so...

spans.text: We don't have enough resources or power to face Eosphorus head-on if we're really going to war, so...

units.rawText: You can spare me the details. Don't worry, I'll try to be a very inefficient tool in his hands.
units.displayText: You can spare me the details. Don't worry, I'll try to be a very inefficient tool in his hands.

spans.text: You can spare me the details. Don't worry, I'll try to be a very inefficient tool in his hands.

units.rawText: Sangoma will relay our progress and the final results.
units.displayText: Sangoma will relay our progress and the final results.

spans.text: Sangoma will relay our progress and the final results.

units.rawText: Is this the reason you sent her to my side?
units.displayText: Is this the reason you sent her to my side?

spans.text: Is this the reason you sent her to my side?

units.rawText: What a cold assumption. Sangoma adamantly volunteered for this.
units.displayText: What a cold assumption. Sangoma adamantly volunteered for this.

spans.text: What a cold assumption. Sangoma adamantly volunteered for this.

units.rawText: And, honoring her wishes, from today onward, she'll be joining the Oasis and therefore, she'll be one of you.
units.displayText: And, honoring her wishes, from today onward, she'll be joining the Oasis and therefore, she'll be one of you.

spans.text: And, honoring her wishes, from today onward, she'll be joining the Oasis and therefore, she'll be one of you.

units.rawText: Sangoma remains silent and smiles softly, turning her head to her new boss.
units.displayText: Sangoma remains silent and smiles softly, turning her head to her new boss.

spans.text: Sangoma remains silent and smiles softly, turning her head to her new boss.

units.rawText: Now I can answer that question of yours.
units.displayText: Now I can answer that question of yours.

spans.text: Now I can answer that question of yours.

units.rawText: Thank you for your efforts made for me and the Oasis, Sangoma. I'd like to ask you again—
units.displayText: Thank you for your efforts made for me and the Oasis, Sangoma. I'd like to ask you again—

spans.text: Thank you for your efforts made for me and the Oasis, Sangoma. I'd like to ask you again—

units.rawText: Do you wish to join the Oasis and stay by my side?
units.displayText: Do you wish to join the Oasis and stay by my side?

spans.text: Do you wish to join the Oasis and stay by my side?

units.rawText: Yes, I do. I look forward to working for you, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Yes, I do. I look forward to working for you, {교수}.

spans.text: Yes, I do. I look forward to working for you,

units.rawText: Sangoma reaches out to the void, as if trying to touch the Professor through the comm link. Moments later, the Ops Room door swings open, and the one who has occupied the purple-haired Doll's thoughts steps in, gently taking her hand with a warm smile.
units.displayText: Sangoma reaches out to the void, as if trying to touch the Professor through the comm link. Moments later, the Ops Room door swings open, and the one who has occupied the purple-haired Doll's thoughts steps in, gently taking her hand with a warm smile.

units.rawText: Eh? Ehhhh?!
units.displayText: Eh? Ehhhh?!

spans.text: Eh? Ehhhh?!

units.rawText: <cmdr>? Were you just using the comms behind the door all this time?
units.displayText: {교수}? Were you just using the comms behind the door all this time?

spans.text: ? Were you just using the comms behind the door all this time?

units.rawText: Uh... Ahem. I thought if I knocked, you might hang up immediately, just as you did the last time.
units.displayText: Uh... Ahem. I thought if I knocked, you might hang up immediately, just as you did the last time.

spans.text: Uh... Ahem. I thought if I knocked, you might hang up immediately, just as you did the last time.

units.rawText: So, I decided to hack into your communications to make sure you and your Boss couldn't just slip away.
units.displayText: So, I decided to hack into your communications to make sure you and your Boss couldn't just slip away.
